literal: Darkness-joining two-actions-both will-not-join God's reality-joining glory those-who-desired with.
translation: The two kinds of actions born of darkness will not touch those who love the true glory of God.
modern: இறைவனின் உண்மையான புகழை விரும்பிப் போற்றுபவர்களிடம், அறியாமை என்னும் இருளால் வரும் நல்வினை, தீவினை ஆகிய இரண்டு வினைகளும் சேராது.
explanation: This couplet explains how devotion frees a person from the cycle of karma. The phrase iruḷ cēr iruviṉai refers to the two types of actions, good and bad, that stem from the darkness of delusion or ignorance. These actions bind the soul to the cycle of birth and death. However, these actions will not attach themselves to those who love and meditate upon the true, meaningful glory of God. By focusing on the ultimate reality, the devotee transcends the ignorance that causes worldly karma.
